title: Indian edtech startup upGrad closes its acquisition of rival Unacademy in an all-stock deal valuing Unacademy at ~$206M, down from its peak $3.5B valuation (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)
summary: Jagmeet Singh / TechCrunch: Indian edtech startup upGrad closes its acquisition of rival Unacademy in an all-stock deal valuing Unacademy at ~$206M, down from its peak $3.5B valuation — Unacademy, once one of India's most valuable edtech startups, has been acquired by rival upGrad at a valuation of just over $200 million …
